subject: design/native-routing-policy-v1
statement: After an upstream caller has selected a harness and declared `role=implementation|review`, one pure resolver reads that exact harness-role's closed, qualified native-profile catalog and returns the unique least-cost profile whose declared semantic provision componentwise dominates the requested execution profile. It returns `exact`, `promoted`, or `unsupported`; it never selects a harness, invokes a model, consults the network, infers from task prose, or reuses another role's result.
